source: 2014/TSB Vol 14 No 12 - Ford Brake Adapter Longer Tabs.pdf
title: Ford Brake Adapter
lead: MOC has developed a new brake adapter for use on various Ford models. This new adapter was created for the brake reservoirs that have thicker tabs where the cap is connected.
body: This new adapter (Part # 98468), is known to fit the 2012 Ford Explorer.
